source: Pinned ATen scalar implementation; reusable contiguous FP32 reference
adaptation: hardsigmoid_kernel specialized to float. TensorIterator maps to a C loop. Standard min/max/clamp keep comparison/select semantics; float math overloads map to equivalent C functions. C++ constexpr constants expand at their use sites. Scalars remain parameters. The proprietary cuDNN backend graph is mechanically emitted from this reference, with separately tested opcode semantics; this is not imported cuDNN source.

specs.name: aten_hardsigmoid_f32
assumptions: contiguous FP32 arrays; output disjoint from inputs
errno and floating exception flags not observed
